attchmntText: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 10, 2025, titled "Tata Consultancy Services announces the appointment of Ms. Aarthi Subramanian as President and Chief Operating Officer and Mr. Mangesh Sathe as Chief Strategy Officer".

Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 10, 2025, titled "TCS Crosses $30 Billion Revenue Milestone, Strong Order Book Reinforces Confidence in Long-Term Resilience".
Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on April 10, 2025, recommended Final Dividend of Rs. 30 per equity share.
Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on April 10, 2025.
